summary: Space background reconciliation starts with a reloadable default30-per-minute cap

replay.detail: No claim/projection replay or input/effect/authority change; every selected pass still reads current state and uses existing effect fences.

compatibility.detail: Background startup/notification/deadline/changed-repeat starts share a monotonic last-start gate, default2s spacing. Pending notification/current-state invalidations are retained; long passes earn no catch-up burst. Default remaining-gap delay is at most2s before one pass, plus processing; multi-pass convergence adds multiple gaps. This delays step-ready mission evaluation, seat preparation/start, due work wakes and recovery/urgent reactions. Independent authority/lease/runtime fences and due bookkeeping remain. Manual reconcile_once controls are not background scheduling.

downtime.detail: No extra migration or restart beyond normal source deployment; no live rollout assigned.

manual.detail: Optional [reconcile] max_passes_per_minute=30, valid1..600. Existing daemon two-minute config reload updates effective rate without a build/restart, preserving prior-start history. Missing/malformed/invalid config retains last good policies and logs changed errors; startup rejects invalid values. Persisting the new nondefault setting requires removing that section before rollback to older strict config readers.

recovery.detail: Supervisor restarts keep last-start history on the same Reconciler. Cancellation of an async wait reserves no start. The30x0.4≈12CPU-seconds/min estimate is unmeasured; no saving or production budget accepted.
